title: Shop — the same database the studio has open

options.content:
These are the rows WebDataStudio is showing on the connection called **SHOP**, read through Grafana's own Postgres datasource. Neither package knows about the other — they share the `pg` resource this app host created, and the credentials come from its parameters.

Open the studio's **Morning** dashboard next to this one: `Customers` and `Orders by status` are the same statements, so the numbers move together.

panels.title: Orders by status
panels.description: The studio's Morning dashboard runs this statement too.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, count(*) AS "orders" FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer, o.status, o.placed_at FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: What each customer has spent
panels.description: A join worth keeping — which is what the studio's "As table" button is for.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS customer, count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, coalesce(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 0) AS total FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total DESC
